title: Kicked Floral Ethiopian Cheese Lasagna
description: A unique Ethiopian-inspired lasagna dish featuring floral notes and a blend of cheeses, perfect for a post-workout meal. This dish combines tarragon-french flavors with tadka spices and raw-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
In a bowl, combine ricotta cheese, tarragon, and tadka spice mix.
In a separate bowl, combine french cheese and chopped raw spinach.
In a baking dish, create a layer of lasagna noodles.
Spread half of the ricotta mixture over the noodles.
Add a layer of french cheese and spinach mixture.
Repeat the layers, starting with the noodles, then the remaining ricotta mixture, and finally another layer of french cheese and spinach.
Drizzle olive oil over the top layer of cheese.
Season with sea salt to taste.
Bake for 35 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
